title: Divide every element toward zero
description: Return a new list in which every element of xs is divided by d with the fraction dropped, that is, rounded toward zero (so -7 divided by 2 gives -3 and 7 divided by -2 gives -3). The order is kept; an empty list gives an empty list. d is never 0 and may be negative.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states truncation toward zero in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
